messages.author: 7a888fc7372988c1
messages.subject: Changing legend text
parts:
Hi all,
How can I alter the legend title of the example below. I'm really
stuck on this!?!
Thanks in advance,
Richard


baya_sum=list()
baya_sum[[4]]=matrix(data=c(1:3),nrow=3,ncol=1)
baya_sum[[7]]=matrix(data=c(1.1,2.1,3.1,0.9,1.9,2.9),nrow=3,ncol=2)

names=c("AT->GC*")

df <- structure(t(baya_sum[[4]]),.Dim=c(1,3),.Dimnames=
list(names,c("A: Low ","B: Medium ", "C: High ") ) )
df.m <- melt(df)
df.m <- cbind(df.m,c(t(baya_sum[[7]][,c(1)])),c(t(baya_sum[[7]]
[,c(2)])))
# df.m <- rename(df.m, c(X1 = "Codon", X2 = "Recombination",))
colnames(df.m)=c("Individual", "Activity","value","errorL","errorH")

avg.plot<-qplot(Individual, value, fill=factor(Activity), data=df.m,
geom="bar", position="dodge")
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
avg.plot+geom_linerange(aes(ymax=errorH, ymin=errorL), position=dodge)
+theme_bw()

messages.subject: Re: Changing legend text
parts:
Hi:

> avg.plot+geom_linerange(aes(ymax=errorH, ymin=errorL), position=dodge) +
+   theme_bw() + scale_fill_hue('Activity')

gave me a legend title 'Activity'.

HTH,
Dennis
